All changes to the WP12 Site Photo Report app. The version in use is shown in the app under **Setup** (bottom panel).

| Version | Date | Changes |
|---|---|---|
| 1.2.6 | 15 Oct 2026 | Pilot update. **Quick post**: a button at the top of the main screen opens the camera; tag the photo on one screen (GPS chainage, side, recent activities as chips, status, remarks; structure, element and RFI no. under *More*) and **Share to WhatsApp**. Caption **below the photo as a table** (default; the photo itself is not covered), **on the photo**, or **text only** (the photo as taken, the caption as the message). Choose what the caption shows (date and time, team, your name, location, activity, BQ / QC ref., RFI no., status, remarks, location strip, app link). The photos also go into the day's report. The same caption choices and the *below the photo* style are on the report screen for **Captioned photos**. **Scan**: a new button at the top reads QR codes with the camera, from a saved image (e.g. received on WhatsApp) or from a pasted message or link, and **Load from a PDF** reads an RFI list or report PDF made by the app; links tapped in WhatsApp open the app at the same place. **RFI request ticket** (RFI inspection list → *Request an inspection*): a late request is made as a ticket image with a QR code and a message with a link; the person keeping the list scans it and **accepts** it (added to the list, marked *Late request*, with its remarks) or **declines** it with a reason, and the app makes a reply ticket for the requester. A request is also confirmed when the requester loads an RFI list that has its ticket no.; one left off a list for its date shows *Not on the list*, and one with no reply after 3 hours or on the day shows *No reply yet* with **Remind**. **RFI inspection list**: *Remarks* for each RFI (own column in the PDF and Word); *List options* at the top with the **PDF layout** (*Table* as WPC's Excel list, or **Schedule**: time order, morning and afternoon, the time in large type, a location strip for each RFI) and **structure lines** for the line diagram; **Share board**: the list as a departures board in time order, up to 8 RFIs per page (each page at most 1600 px tall, so WhatsApp keeps it sharp), with an alignment strip down the right marking each list no. at its chainage; **Board PDF**; a revision no. when the list is shared again after changes. The whole list travels **inside the RFI list PDF and the board PDF** and in the **link in the message**, not in QR codes (a phone camera cannot read a long list from a code). **Today's RFIs**: an RFI list loaded on an inspector's phone (tap the link, **Scan → Load from a PDF**, or paste the message) shows on the main screen in time order with a countdown, **Start record** (take the photos already tagged with the RFI no., activity, structure and chainage from the list) and *Inspected*. **Report record**: page 1 of the PDF report carries the report record QR code (orange frame) and the *Get the app* QR code (no longer in the last page footer of the report); another phone scans the record into its **Register** (the code holds only the ref. no., name, number of photos and chainages, so a phone camera reads it), and **Register → Import PDF** reads every photo's details from the PDF itself. **CST sections line**: CST-S1 to CST-S5 (62+700, 65+660, 68+620, 71+580, 74+540, 77+508) under the location strip, with *CST structures* for photos at a structure; on for team CST; the sections can be edited in Setup → Project (names, chainages, the structures tag), with *Use project sections* to go back. **Other references**: memos, specifications, letters, method statements and other documents in the drawing library (choose the type), numbered M1, S1, L1 … in captions and on the *References* pages. **Snippet editor zoom**: pinch with two fingers, **+ / −**, **Fit**, and **Move** to drag around a zoomed drawing or document before boxing the part to keep. The *Used on photos* line and the note under the snippets now read for drawings and documents. **App link** on a caption prints the app's address at the end of the caption (Quick post and captioned photos). A request still waiting can be **withdrawn**; handled requests can be removed. **Pilot round 2**: **Quick post** opens your gallery (for photos taken with the phone's camera app; the in-app camera is a button, and Setup can change what opens), **activity and structure are chosen in drawers**, and the location has **Chainage to** and **Elsewhere** with a place (lab, office) like the photo card. **Photos taken in the app keep their camera original**: *Save to phone* is offered after each photo (Android: Downloads; iPhone: share menu, Save Image), Setup → *Photos and Quick post* can save at once or stop asking, and **Save ZIP** can include the originals. **RFI inspection list** is now three steps (RFIs, Layout, Share); a new **Schedule, 2 columns** layout for long lists; **Preview the board** before sharing; *Requests* is a fold-out and the scanner sheet is simpler (paste the link first; camera on request). **Audit fixes**: the app tells you when the phone refuses to store something (full storage), the app opens from its saved copy after 4 seconds on a weak signal, and the QR reader is saved for offline use. **Pilot round 3**: **Quick post** does nothing when opened (choose *Gallery* or *Take photo*; Setup can change that), has a *Settings ›* link to *Photos and Quick post*, shows **+ Chainage to** only when tapped (× Remove takes it away) and lines it up under *Chainage (from)*; structure and status can be **typed** (*Other…*) as on the photo card; photos taken in the app are **saved to the phone at once** by default. **Requests** moved to the top of RFI list step 1. **Zone colours** (Schedule, Schedule 2 columns, board and the app list): a coloured stripe and legend by zone, switch *Colour by zone*. **Photos can be collapsed** like the Claimpack lines: *Collapse* on a photo, *Collapse all / Expand all* in the list header. **Pilot round 4**: the top bar on a phone shows the whole title (two lines) instead of cutting it; collapsed photos use the full width; the **QR codes on page 1 of the PDF report moved to the footer corners** (Scan for the app at the bottom right, the report record at the bottom left, which is **off by default**; the photo log is in the PDF itself, *Register → Import PDF*); the **CST sections line is blue-grey and thin** so it is not mistaken for the project's zone bar; **documentation site**: the guide, roadmap and change list as web pages with a modern theme (the `docs` folder, built from the .md files). **Scan a document or page** (experimental, off by default; Setup → Experimental features): a button beside *Take photo* and a *Scan page* tile in Quick post; take a photo of a page, drag the four corner handles onto it, and the app straightens it into a flat page, **black and white** like a scan or **in colour**; *Use the whole photo* skips the straightening. The page goes in as a normal photo marked *Scanned page* (kept at up to 2400 px so print stays readable). Corners are placed by hand; automatic corner finding is planned for v1.3. |
| 1.2.5 | 13 Oct 2026 | **Preview before sharing**: *Preview* on the report screen, on each RFI photo record and on the RFI inspection list shows the PDF page by page in the app, with Share / Save below it. **Word document (experimental)**: **Save Word** saves the report, an RFI photo record or the RFI inspection list as an editable .docx set out like the PDF (the same header with logos, title and detail boxes on every page, tables, photos 2 × 2 or 2 per page with their numbers and captions, drawing references, sign-off lines, page numbers and the credit line). The Word file is always saved to the phone (Downloads or Files), not shared, with **Save again** in the message bar if nothing appeared; open it in Word or WPS, edit, and send it from there. **Sharing after a slow build**: when a PDF takes a few seconds to make, some phones no longer allow the share; the message bar at the bottom now says *… is ready* with a **Share** button to send it (report, RFI records, RFI list, preview). Errors while making a file now show in the message bar. **Drawing references (experimental)**: attach a snippet of a drawing (layout plan, structure detail, schedule) to a photo. On the photo card, **+ Drawing ref** opens the drawing library on the phone; **+ Add a drawing snippet** takes a **PDF drawing** (choose the page; opened on the phone with a PDF viewer that downloads the first time) or an image (JPG, PNG, HEIC, screenshot), lets you drag a box over the part to keep, and asks for the drawing no. (the usual start *WD/JKR/WP12/CS/* is filled in and can be changed, recent trades such as *DR/PNP/* are one tap; a drawing no. in the file name is picked up), rev., title, what the snippet shows, and optionally a structure and chainage range (filled in from a title such as *… FROM CH. 63400.000 TO CH. 64100.000*). Drawings with the same structure or a matching chainage are suggested on the photo card for one-tap attaching. The PDF report and the RFI photo record show *Drawing: D1 WD/JKR/WP12/…* in the photo caption and print each snippet on **Drawing reference** pages at the end, with the photos that refer to it: a wide snippet (plan, schedule) takes the full width, two upright snippets (sections, details) share a row. **Drawing pages** on the report screen: *Auto*, *1 per page* (fit to the page; a wide drawing gets a landscape page), *2 per page* or *4 per page*. **Scan with camera**: take a photo of a paper drawing, drag the 4 corners onto the sheet and tap *Straighten* (an A-size sheet is set to its exact shape); *Enhance* gives a clean white background with dark lines. Captioned photos carry the drawing no. *Tag selected* can attach drawings to several photos. Setup → *Experimental features* shows or hides it and opens the library. Register and CSV: new column *Drawing refs* at the end. **Credit line**: PDF pages carry a small line *Generated with WP12 Site Photo Report v1.2.5* under the footer, the PDF file properties name the app, and captioned photos carry it in their file data (not on the picture). **2 photos per page is now the default** for everyone (larger photos; 4 per page is still one tap away), and the choice is shown as two page pictures with the page count for each. **Report ref. no. fix**: each report on a phone now gets its own no. A no. counts as used once it is shown on the report screen, so *New report* always gives the next one, even if the last draft was never shared; and when the photos of a report that was already shared or saved are changed (e.g. removed and replaced with the next activity's photos), the next report gets the next no. and its own Register line (before, it kept the same no. and replaced the earlier Register line). Editing captions or details keeps the no. **Share this app**: Setup shows a QR code of the app's address, with *Share link* and *Copy link*. **QR code on PDFs**: a small QR code to the app at the right end of the footer on the last page of the report, RFI photo records and the RFI list (*Scan for the app*); Setup can switch it off. **Team logos from the team setup**: team CST gets the CST logo on the right, WPC and SOR keep the setup logos; a logo chosen on the phone still comes first. **Share Word** beside *Save Word* (report, RFI photo records, RFI list) on phones that can share files. **Captioned photos**: *Preview* to see them before sharing, and tick boxes for the photo no. (now off by default) and the team on the first caption line. **Alignment diagram**: the total length (14.81 km) and the length of each zone above the line. **Location strip on each photo**: a small line of the whole alignment with the zones, the photo's zone stronger and a marker at its chainage, in the PDF and on captioned photos (not in Word). On by default under the caption; *Top of the photo* or *Off* on the report screen. **RFI inspection list line diagram (experimental)**: tick *Include a line diagram* to show each RFI's location along the alignment, marked with its list no. and time of inspection, above the table; RFIs elsewhere (e.g. the site laboratory) are listed under it. **Same photo twice**: adding a photo that is already in the report is skipped, with a note. **PDF size** shown on the report screen once the PDF is made. |

The **element** box now names what to type for the activity: *Sampling point* (water, air and noise monitoring, sampling, instrumentation), *Element* (bridges, culverts, a structure), *Layer / level* (earthworks, pavement) or *Element / point*; a sampling point prints as *Sampling point W1*, and the PDF column reads *Structure / element*. **Report ref. no.** on every report, e.g. *WP12-WPC-SYA-20261012-1* (package, team, initials, date, report no. of the day on this phone), set from the initials in Report details and editable on the report screen; printed in the PDF header and footer, the WhatsApp text, the RFI photo record, the file names and the register. **Logos for each team** (Setup → Report logos), e.g. JKR + WPC for WPC reports and JKR + CST for CST internal reports, as an image or a text; the check before sharing names the team. **HEIC / HEIF photos** can be added on Android and laptops (converted on the phone; the converter downloads the first time it is needed), with their date and GPS. **Period report (experimental)**: Report type *Period* keeps collecting photos over several days and makes one report for the week or month: a progress table over the period (latest status and progress for each activity and place), then the photos day by day; the WhatsApp text is grouped by day. **Date taken** for photos with no camera date (e.g. saved from WhatsApp): the date is read from the file name where it has one (e.g. *IMG-20261010-WA0012.jpg*), otherwise the file's date is used and flagged; the card shows a *Date taken* box to check or change it, *Tag selected* can set it for several photos, and a period report lists photos whose date is not confirmed or outside the period. **Test result** for testing and sampling activities (Passed, Failed, Retest required, Pending test result, Pending official test result, or your own), printed with the status, e.g. *Inspected, Result: Pending test result*, and kept in the register (new CSV column *Test result*). **Remove selected photos** in one step, with Undo. **Tidier screen**: the photo on each card is smaller and the card is shorter (Structure beside the element box, Progress beside Status); **New report** is a red button at the top of the photo list and goes back to a Daily report; a report date that is not today shows in orange on the closed Report details line. The ZIP archive also holds *report_data.json* for compiling reports later. Register and CSV: new columns *Place*, *Progress %*, *Report ref*, *Photo date* (photos) and *Report ref*, *Date to* (reports), added at the end. |

Register and team sheet: the RFI *Stage* and *Result* columns replaced by *Photo status*. Fixed: summary table headings overlapping in bilingual reports; long header values (e.g. several zones) cut off, now shortened, e.g. *CST Z1, Z3, Z4*; zones listed in photo order instead of zone order; "BQ BQ" in the Register photo list. ## How a revision is recorded

1. The version number in the app (`index.html`) goes up for every change: a third number for small additions or fixes between planned releases (1.2 → 1.2.1), the second number for a planned release in the roadmap (1.2 → 1.3), and the first number for a major change (2.0).
2. A row is added at the top of the table above.
3. The GitHub commit message starts with the version, e.g. `v1.2 – RFI record: Inspected by (CST)`.
